done_when: In a repo whose tests run in CI, forge merge after main moved pushes the merged branch and waits for the pull request checks instead of running tests on the laptop, and a repo whose tests run on the laptop keeps today's local retest
why: When tests run in CI and main moved before a merge, forge merge retests the merged branch on the laptop test lane for every repo except Python apps with broad pytest selection, so client merges wait in the laptop queue
